title: MV/MZ RPG MAKER MV/ MZ TO APK/AAB TOOLS UPDATE 1.3

posts.author: Anaryx_plugin
posts.body:
For those of you who often get stuck on the "how to export RPG Maker to Android without any hassle" part, here's the tool I use every day: AG APK Builder v1.3.
What's in version 1.2:
Build APK and AAB in one go
. APK for testing directly on your phone, AAB for uploading to the Play Store​
Target SDK 35 (Android 15)
, now meets Google Play's minimum requirements
Keystore manage
r — can generate a new keystore or use an existing one. This is crucial if you want to update apps in the Play Store without losing ownership
Built-in ADB tools
— connect your device via USB or Wi-Fi (Android 11+), install APKs, launch apps, all from within the builder without opening a terminal
WebView Preview
— preview your game on a simulated phone screen before building. Useful for early detection of messy layouts
Play Asset Delivery
— For games over 150MB, assets can be separated from the main APK to keep the base APK size small
Automatically
inject icons from the www folder, or choose a custom PNG
Built-in error dictionary
— If the build fails, the error code immediately explains the cause and solution
Free
, standalone, no Android Studio required, no Android coding required

Some documentation may be inaccurate because I haven't updated it to the latest version, this is still an old version.
What's in version 1.3:
AdMob Plugin (Full & Demo, EN + ID)
: Full Google AdMob integration directly from RPG Maker MZ Plugin Commands, no coding required.
Banner Ads with customizable position (top/bottom) and size (Adaptive, Banner, Large, Medium Rectangle, Full, Leaderboard).
Interstitial Ads with Switch callback on close.
Rewarded Ads with Switch and Variable reward callbacks for RPG Maker event integration.
App Open Ads shown when the application is launched.
Auto-banner on map start option.
Queue system: commands are held and executed automatically once the AdMob SDK is ready.
On-screen debug alert overlay and console log for easy testing.
Available in four versions: Full EN, Full ID, Demo EN, Demo ID.
Notification Plugin
: Schedule local push notifications to re-engage players.
Custom title and message per notification.
Delay and scheduled time support.
Repeating notification option.
Cancel notification support.
Various stability improvements across the builder.
Minor bug fixes based on v1.2 user feedback.

posts.author: Anaryx_plugin
posts.body:
Thanks for the kind words!
Yes, AG APK Builder uses a built-in bundled environment, so you don't need to install Java separately.
I understand the frustration with Java/Gradle version conflicts , that's actually one of the reasons I designed it this way, to avoid setup issues and make the process smoother.
The goal is to let developers focus on their games rather than struggling with build errors.
Also, thanks for pointing out the duplicate screenshots , I'll fix them soon. Even if Android isn't your primary target, feel free to test it anytime just for fun. It's free to use.
